units.source_text: 恰巧这时一场骤雨席卷而来。

en.t: Just then, a sudden downpour swept in.

units.source_text: 转眼间，庭院里的草坪都被雨水淹没了。

en.t: In the blink of an eye, the lawn in the garden was submerged by rainwater.

units.source_text: 风雨敲打在急忙关上的挡雨板上。

en.t: The wind and rain beat against the rain shutters that had been hurriedly closed.

units.source_text: 这是七段脱口而出的一句得意的俏皮话，

en.t: This was a proud little witticism that the seventh dan had blurted out,

units.source_text: 仿佛也是他的一声心满意足的呼唤。

en.t: as if it were also a satisfied cry from his heart.
